notes.title: Explanation Regarding the Migration of Existing Game Data on Mobile Device
notes.notes:
Important Reminder: If you have existing game data on your mobile device and want to continue playing on Steam, please bind your game account to your Steam account on your mobile device first to avoid losing existing data.

Please follow the steps below on your mobile device BEFORE launching the game on Steam:
1) Launch the game and stay on the title screen
2) Click on the Profile icon in the top left corner to open NetEase Account Management
3) Click on "Bind Account"
4) Select Steam
5) Log in with Steam
6) Complete binding

To ensure it is properly bound:
Return to the "Bind Account" tab and make sure it says "Unbind" instead of "Bind" next to Steam. If it does, your account is properly bound to Steam.

What's next?
Launch the game on Steam, and you will have access to your existing game data.
